entries.zh: 演武台；操练士兵的校场、练武台
entries.en: drill ground; platform for mustering and training soldiers

entries.zh: 迎送；迎接并送行（迎送宾客，亦指迎神送神之仪）
entries.en: to welcome and see off (guests or deities); ceremonial reception and escort

entries.zh: 打醮；僧道设坛建醮、举行斋醮法会（bonços 指僧众）
entries.en: to hold a jiao offering ritual; procession of the bonzes (monks' ceremonial festival)

entries.zh: 走境；抬神像出巡、绕境巡游
entries.en: deity procession around the parish bounds; carrying idols on ceremonial tour

entries.notes: 词头为缩写 Proass.，展开依赖推断（疑为 proceso），据汉字「案」与闽南音写释义

entries.en: dossier; records or file of a lawsuit
entries.notes: 闽南音写栏另含一项无对应汉字（未纳入释义），音写与汉字的对应关系有待复核，故降置信

entries.zh: 案卷；公案文书、案牍档案
entries.en: case files; legal dossier or archive

entries.zh: 营；营求、谋取（谋求营生、经营求利）；亦指军营、营垒
entries.en: to seek after, strive to obtain (a living); also: camp

entries.notes: 闽南音写栏第二项带[疑]且无对应汉字，释义以汉字「求」与 procurar 为据

entries.zh: 立业；立业成家、置办产业或谋得职业
entries.en: to establish a livelihood; to acquire property or a trade/office
entries.notes: 西语词头含[疑]且文字有损（疑为 adquirir hacienda o oficio），与「立业」义合

entries.zh: 掌进；掌管进项、经手收益（坐收进益）
entries.en: to hold and receive income; to manage proceeds (e.g. benefice revenues)
entries.notes: 西语词头文字残乱且带[疑]（auenta/Bro/beneficios 难确读），据汉字「掌进」与 procurar 语境释义

entries.zh: 原告；提起诉讼者、兴讼之人
entries.en: plaintiff; the one who institutes the lawsuit (glossed in the manuscript as procurador)

entries.notes: 仅存西语词头 Por digo & liberal.（疑为 Pródigo y liberal「挥霍而慷慨」），汉字、闽南音写、官话三栏皆空，无从互证

entries.zh: 太僭；僭越逾分、用度僭侈（挥霍逾礼）；字或作「太惯」，存疑
entries.en: prodigal; extravagantly presumptuous, spending beyond one's station
entries.notes: 西语词头含[疑]，汉字栏僭/惯两形未定；据 pródigo（挥霍逾分者）释义

entries.zh: 狼汤（疑为「浪荡」形近之讹）；放荡无度、挥霍游荡
entries.en: prodigal; dissolute and squandering (Chinese gloss likely corrupt for 浪荡)
entries.notes: 汉字「狼汤」不成词、闽南音写两读归属存疑，据西语 prodigo（挥霍放荡者）语境定释义

entries.zh: 开；（草木）开花结果、产出（如树结果实）
entries.en: to produce, bear (fruit) — said of a tree
entries.notes: 音号栏 T99（污损难辨），按纪律降为低置信；释义据西语 producir 与汉字「开」

entries.zh: 开楼（疑为「开枝」之讹）；分枝繁生、结出其余果实
entries.en: to put forth many branches and bear the rest of the fruit
entries.notes: 西语词头含[疑]、音号栏 T99，且闽南音写栏混入西语、汉字「开楼」疑讹，释义存疑

entries.zh: 谶语；谶语预言、占验祸福之言；字或作「识语」，存疑
entries.en: to prophesy; prophetic words, ominous sayings
entries.notes: 汉字栏讖/識两形存疑，据西语 Proheticar（说预言）与闽南音写判为「谶语」
